[SWS_DM_01346] Handling negative return values of ara::diag::EcuResetRequest::ExecuteReset
⌈
If
ara::diag::EcuResetRe-
quest::ExecuteReset returns any of the defined error codes in [SWS_DM_01014],
the Diagnostic Server instance shall return a Negative Response with NRC
equal to the returned error code, if a final response to the request was not sent yet.
⌋
